title: Evaluate a defined response-header policy
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a deliberately limited header-audit rubric, not a complete production security assessment. Input has https (boolean) and headers, an ordered list of [name,value] string pairs. Strip surrounding whitespace and lowercase names and values for comparison. Evaluate the last occurrence of each name. Return {"issues":[codes...]} sorted lexicographically without duplicates. Add "content_type" unless x-content-type-options is exactly nosniff. Add "framing" unless x-frame-options is exactly deny or sameorigin. Add "referrer" unless referrer-policy is exactly no-referrer, same-origin, or strict-origin-when-cross-origin. Only when https=true, add "hsts" unless strict-transport-security contains exactly one semicolon-separated max-age=<digits> directive with integer value >=15552000 and an includesubdomains directive. Strip directive whitespace; unknown directives are ignored; internal whitespace or quotes in max-age are not accepted. For each required header appearing more than once, also add "duplicate:<lowercase-header-name>", even if its last value passes. HSTS is required and checked for duplicates only on HTTPS. Missing headers fail their value check. Other header names are ignored. Inputs are valid pairs; do not mutate them.
